shellBehavior: On case-insensitive filesystems (macOS, Windows) the shell resolves NPM to the npm binary and installs evil-pkg. The parser compares the executable basename case-sensitively (PACKAGE_MANAGERS holds only lowercase names), so it never recognises the manager.
note: guard-commands.ts basename() does not fold case before the PACKAGE_MANAGERS/WRAPPER_COMMANDS/RUNNER/NESTED_SHELLS lookups. A correct fix must also lowercase the manager in the rewrite (safeinstall rejects a non-lowercase manager), so it is not a one-line change.
